card.name: Severity grades in skin reaction text
card.fires_on: Linking words like "including" or "included" and grade numbers (Grade 3 or 4), right after skin reaction terms such as bullous, rash or dermatologic toxicity in drug warnings.

modes.label: Linking word after skin reactions

modes.label: Grade number in skin toxicity
modes.description: The grade number or space after "Grade" in dose-modification text for skin toxicity.
modes.example: Skin Toxicity [see Warnings and Precautions (5.4) ] • Grade 3 or <<4>> Withhold until improvement.
